name: agent-fix
description: Universal diagnostic/fix catalog for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Hermes, ...)

issues.title: npm postinstall skipped -> native binary missing
symptoms: opencode --version fails with 'postinstall script was not run'
claude --version fails with 'native binary not installed'
GUI tools show the agent as 'installed but cannot run'

issues.title: GUI apps (CC-Switch etc.) cannot see agent binaries
symptoms: CC-Switch or other GUI reports 'installed - cannot run'
command works in terminal but not in GUI-launched processes

checks.name: npm global dir in GUI PATH
checks.cmd: { reg query "HKCU\Environment" /v Path 2>/dev/null; reg query "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Environment" /v Path 2>/dev/null; } | tr -d '\r' | grep -qiE 'npm' && echo FOUND || echo MISSING

checks.name: hermes bin dir in GUI PATH
checks.cmd: { reg query "HKCU\Environment" /v Path 2>/dev/null; reg query "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Environment" /v Path 2>/dev/null; } | tr -d '\r' | grep -qiE 'hermes' && echo FOUND || echo MISSING

fixes.name: Add npm global dir to user PATH (registry)
fixes.cmd: powershell -NoProfile -Command "\$d=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User');\$p=(npm config get prefix);if(\$d -notmatch [regex]::Escape(\$p)){[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path',\$d+';'+\$p,'User');Write-Output ('Added: '+\$p)}else{Write-Output 'npm dir already in user PATH'}"

fixes.name: Add hermes bin dir to user PATH (registry)
fixes.cmd: powershell -NoProfile -Command "\$d=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User');\$p=(Split-Path (Get-Command hermes -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source -Parent);if(\$p -and \$d -notmatch [regex]::Escape(\$p)){[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path',\$d+';'+\$p,'User');Write-Output ('Added: '+\$p)}else{Write-Output 'hermes dir already in user PATH or hermes not found'}"

verify.name: npm dir visible to GUI PATH
verify.cmd: { reg query "HKCU\Environment" /v Path 2>/dev/null; reg query "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Environment" /v Path 2>/dev/null; } | tr -d '\r' | grep -qiE 'npm' && echo OK || echo STILL-MISSING

verify.name: hermes dir visible to GUI PATH
verify.cmd: { reg query "HKCU\Environment" /v Path 2>/dev/null; reg query "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Environment" /v Path 2>/dev/null; } | tr -d '\r' | grep -qiE 'hermes' && echo OK || echo STILL-MISSING

issues.title: Node too old for the agent
symptoms: agent crashes at startup with a SyntaxError or engines message

fixes.name: Install Node LTS via nvm-windows/fnm (manual, see doc)
fixes.cmd: echo 'Manual step: install Node LTS (nvm install lts && nvm use lts on Windows; nvm install --lts on POSIX), then reinstall global agents. See fixes/node-version.md'

issues.title: npm registry slow or unreachable
symptoms: npm install/upgrade hangs or fails with ETIMEDOUT/ECONNRESET
agent upgrades fail mid-way and leave postinstall skipped

issues.title: Agent not logged in / expired auth / missing API key
symptoms: 'Not logged in' or 401 Unauthorized on every prompt

checks.name: claude credential file or auth env present
checks.cmd: test -f "$HOME/.claude/.credentials.json" && echo OK || { env | grep -qE 'ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN|ANTHROPIC_API_KEY' && echo OK || echo NO; }

checks.name: codex auth file or API key env present
checks.cmd: test -f "$HOME/.codex/auth.json" && echo OK || { env | grep -qE 'OPENAI_API_KEY' && echo OK || echo NO; }

fixes.name: Interactive login (manual, see doc)
fixes.cmd: echo 'Manual step: run claude /login or codex login (or set the right API-key env). See fixes/agent-auth.md'

verify.name: claude /login or env auth configured
verify.cmd: echo 'Verify with a real prompt: claude "ping" --print'

issues.title: Agent not pointed at DeepSeek API
symptoms: want to run agents on DeepSeek models (deepseek-chat / deepseek-reasoner)
401 or 'model not found' after switching provider

checks.name: a DeepSeek or Anthropic-compatible key is set
checks.cmd: env | grep -qE 'DEEPSEEK_API_KEY|ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN|ANTHROPIC_API_KEY|OPENAI_API_KEY' && echo SET || echo UNSET

fixes.name: Configure DeepSeek per agent (manual, see doc)
fixes.cmd: echo 'Manual step: set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic for Claude Code, OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://api.deepseek.com for Codex/OpenCode. See fixes/deepseek-provider.md'

verify.name: model round-trip
verify.cmd: echo 'Verify with a real model call: claude "say hi" --print'
